prompt:
A wide establishing vista of Seoul in a far-future cyberpunk world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: Seoul two centuries from now, a vertical far-future megacity: arcology towers kilometres tall piercing the clouds, linked by glowing sky-bridges at many levels; the old transmission tower on the southern mountain rebuilt as a colossal space-elevator spire whose cable of light climbs straight into orbit; the wide river spanned by stacked tiers of luminous maglev arches; streams of flying vehicles moving in lanes of light between the towers; giant holographic guardian beasts and dancheong patterns projected across the sky; the old palace preserved as a small island of curved tiled roofs under a vast glass dome, deep among the towers; rain falling through layers of light.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.

generation.tool: OpenAI 그림 API(claude 세션 — 서울 전경 시험)
